name: Bajo las Rosas
source:
After a rushed move, a small apartment with a garden seemed like the perfect refuge. A fresh start, a little peace. Until one careless mistake ruins everything.

The pain from the wound is the least of your worries. What’s truly unsettling is him—your neighbor—who appears out of nowhere to help you.

There’s something about his smile, his warmth… the strange familiarity in his gaze. Like he knows you better than you know yourself. Stirring memories you thought were long buried.

Can you trust him? Can you trust yourself?

The roses are about to bloom… but their thorns might tear you apart.
